values.subject: Logistics team: Collecting travel precautions (internal)
values.body_text: These were filled out by our team members themselves. I’m forwarding them to you as-is; handle them as you see fit. Wang Lei said his ears become unbearable after spending too long in the noisier areas of the workshop; Zhang Qian is sensitive to dust and coughed continuously the last time she went to the grinding area; Chen Yu suffers badly from motion sickness and needs to sit in the front on long trips; Miguel Santos can only understand about half of spoken Chinese and would like safety instructions in English. Don’t post these points in the group or pass them to the supplier verbatim.
